title: mcp.call/v1 request
description: Approved MCP tools/call through change.propose/v1 only. Observe mcp.tools/v1 Evidence first. operation="call", target.locator=the authorized tool name. One /call SET value={"arguments":{...},"read_back":{"name":"authorized_read_tool","arguments":{...},"checks":[{"path":"/field","equals":"expected value"}]}}. Each check uses equals or one_of, with a JSON Pointer into the parsed read result. precondition.revision=catalog_hash; verification={"method":"READ_BACK","paths":["/call"]}. Both tools and all arguments/checks are approved together. Use the exact string ${effect_id} for a platform-owned operation ID in arguments and read-back checks; the platform substitutes the original Effect UUID. Unknown outcomes are never resent. Original receipt recovery requires a read-back equals check against ${effect_id}; otherwise keep the outcome unknown. Application-specific prerequisites and business verdicts remain defined by the Skill. Returned URLs are not downloaded or saved artifacts.
